about: Salmon Arm is a city on the shore of Shuswap Lake in British Columbia’s Interior, at the head of Salmon Arm bay. Agriculture, tourism, and Highway 1 services shape a lakeside centre known for beaches, foreshore walks, and surrounding orchard and dairy country. About 19,000 people live in Salmon Arm.
